An '''atmosphere-filtration turbine''' was a device used to filter air on [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]-operated [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Kadavo slave processing facility]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] used such a device.
